caption:
The video captures a fixed view of a sunset sky over a silhouetted foreground, where dark cumulus clouds are already drifting and reshaping across the scene. A peaked-roof house stands on the right-center, while a lattice scaffold and a curved streetlight pole sit on the left. The clouds continuously reshape themselves relative to the static roofline, with individual lobes shifting and merging as the backlit sun gap glows near the horizon. The view remains stable, with the foreground silhouettes staying in place.
The bright sunlit opening changes shape and position. Initially it appears as a horizontal yellow band low on the right, then narrows into a more vertical, brighter slot near the center-right, while an orange patch on the left widens and the cloud edges around the opening become more ragged. Above, the sky loses its warm tint and fades toward a paler pink-grey, and the overall glow dims slightly.
A small orange glow on the building silhouette stays constant in position and brightness, remaining visible against the dark roofline.
